bio: Postdoctoral Research Fellow Social and Behavioral Sciences, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Social and Behavioral Sciences Emily Dore is an interdisciplinary researcher that studies structural determinants of health with a life course perspective. Her research aims to inform social and economic policies that decrease health disparities. She is currently a postdoctoral research fellow at the Social Policies for Health Equity Research (SPHERE) Center at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. PhD, Sociology Emory University
